name: Bracket Order Rail
note: Entry with take-profit and stop legs on one shared price rail. Sliders move the legs; the risk and reward spans, leg prices and R:R re-render with a spring, and the live last price flashes green or red on each tick.
html:
BRACKET ESZ5 BUY 2 5812.25
5798.50 ENTRY 5812.25 5841.75
R:R 2.15 risk $1,375 reward $2,950

name: OCO Pair Ticket
note: Two linked exit legs joined by a live brace with a pulse running down it. Print either side: the filled leg glows and locks in, then its twin is struck through and marked cancelled 380ms later.
html:
OCO TSLA LONG 200 @ 184.62 ARMED
LMT SELL 200 189.40 ▲ +2.59% WORKING
STP SELL 200 181.10 ▼ -1.90% WORKING

name: Trailing Stop Dial
note: Drag the dial or use arrow keys (role=slider, Home/End supported) to set trail distance. The SVG arc sweeps, the stop ratchets up under a live high-water mark and the cushion bar drains as price falls back.
html:
TRAIL STOPBTC-USDSELL 0.75
1.20% trail

PEAK ▲62,905

cushion +268

name: Iceberg Split Tank
note: Visible tranche above a dashed waterline, hidden reserve as submerged blocks below. Prints eat the shown clip in irregular chunks, a reserve block surfaces and the clip refills with a spring; the slider re-cuts display size.
html:
ICEBERG MSFT SELL 25,000 431.20
shown 2,500
waterline
hidden 22,500 filled 0 refills 9

name: TWAP Slice Scheduler
note: A TWAP schedule drawn as slice columns with a sweeping clock line. Each slice grows as it works then turns green when done, avg price and bp slippage recompute, and duration chips re-cut the schedule and restart the run.
html:
TWAP AAPL BUY 40,000 09:31:24
09:3012 slices · 2.5m10:00
done 0/40,000 avg 227.38 ▼ -1.4 bp
participation 8.4%

name: Basket Legs Sender
note: Four legs with weight bars; each row is a real toggle button that drops a leg in or out while gross and net count to their new value. Sending walks the live legs with a staggered acknowledgement and a working counter.
html:
BASKET 4 legs gross $994k
net +$649k ▲ long

name: Quick Trade Numpad
note: A twelve-key size pad: keys depress with a spring and ripple, the notional recomputes on every digit, and buy or sell prints a signed confirmation against a mark that ticks green or red. Digits and Backspace also work from the keyboard when the panel has focus.
html:
BTC-USD62,418.50
0.35BTC
≈ $21,846
tap keys or type digits

name: Hotkey Trading Desk
note: Focus the panel and type B, S, F, size presets 1-3 or Esc — keydown is bound to the panel, never the document, so it never hijacks the page. Caps depress on the real keystroke and each action slides a signed line onto the blotter while position, average and P/L update.
html:
HOTKEYS NQZ5 click panel, then type
pos FLAT avg -- P/L $0
